info.title: SDKWork Missory App API
info.description: Missory (念忆) app-api surface: people, relationships, memories, stories, reminders, and the draft-only social AI assistant. Authority contract for the `sdkwork-missory-app-api` API authority mounted under the locked app-api prefix.

get.summary: Retrieve the owner profile of the current user.

put.summary: Update the owner profile of the current user.

get.summary: List persons with optional keyword and relationship-type filters.
Retrieve a person with relationships, recent memories, and stats.

delete.summary: Delete a person and its owned relationships and memory links.

post.summary: Add or update the owner-to-person relationship.
Extract candidate memories from free text (AI assist, candidates only).

get.summary: Retrieve one memory including source and inference metadata.

post.summary: Confirm a candidate or inference memory into a user-confirmed fact.
Reject a candidate or inference memory.
Create a story bundling participants, events, and memories.

get.summary: Retrieve one story with its timeline.

post.summary: Create (or regenerate) the AI summary of a story.

get.summary: List derived reminders (long-uncontacted, birthday, commitment, events).

post.summary: Snooze a derived reminder for a number of days.

get.summary: Home digest — today relations, recent memories, recent persons.

post.summary: Ask the social agent a person/relationship/memory question.
Build a meeting briefing for one person.
Draft a message (birthday, check-in) — draft only, never auto-sent.
Summarize pasted chat text and produce candidate memories.

MissoryPersonRequestContext.description: Resolved request identity (never client-writable at create/update bodies).

birthday.description: MM-DD or full date; drives birthday reminders.

relationshipTypes.description: Optional initial relationship types on create.

personId.description: Optional target person; omitted resolves by name mentions in text.

data.description: Operation-specific payload typed per response schema.

item.description: Single-resource payload typed per response schema.
